_note: Plain language guide used to explain YouCam skin scores. General cosmetic information, not medical advice. Ingredient notes reflect widely published dermatology guidance; review before release.

salicylic_acid.name: Salicylic acid (BHA)
salicylic_acid.why: dissolves into oil, so it can clear inside pores
salicylic_acid.caution: Start two or three nights a week. Skip it on retinoid nights.

benzoyl_peroxide.name: Benzoyl peroxide
benzoyl_peroxide.why: reduces the bacteria linked to breakouts
benzoyl_peroxide.caution: Can bleach towels and pillowcases. Start with 2.5%.

adapalene.name: Adapalene (a retinoid)
adapalene.why: keeps pores from clogging and evens texture over months
adapalene.caution: Pea sized amount, every other night at first. Ask a pharmacist first if pregnant or planning to be.

retinol.name: Retinol
retinol.why: speeds up cell turnover, which softens fine lines and rough texture over time
retinol.caution: Every other night at first. Ask a pharmacist first if pregnant or planning to be.

niacinamide.name: Niacinamide
niacinamide.why: supports the skin barrier and can reduce the look of oil, pores and redness

azelaic_acid.name: Azelaic acid
azelaic_acid.why: calms redness and fades marks left by breakouts
azelaic_acid.caution: May tingle for the first week.

hyaluronic_acid.name: Hyaluronic acid
hyaluronic_acid.why: holds water in the top layer of skin
hyaluronic_acid.caution: Apply to damp skin, then seal with moisturiser.

ceramides.name: Ceramides
ceramides.why: refill the fats that keep water in and irritants out

glycolic_acid.name: Glycolic or lactic acid (AHA)
glycolic_acid.why: loosens dull surface cells for smoother, brighter skin
glycolic_acid.caution: Two or three nights a week. Skip it on retinoid nights.

vitamin_c.name: Vitamin C
vitamin_c.why: helps even tone and adds antioxidant protection under sunscreen

peptides.name: Peptides
peptides.why: support the look of firmer skin

sunscreen.name: Broad spectrum sunscreen, SPF 30 or more
sunscreen.why: sun is the main driver of spots, lines and loss of firmness

acne.label: Breakouts
acne.what: spots and blemishes YouCam found on the face
habits: Avoid picking, it leaves marks that last longer than the spot.
acne.see_pro: Painful, deep or scarring breakouts deserve a visit to a doctor or dermatologist.

moisture.label: Hydration
moisture.what: how well the skin holds water
habits: Moisturise within a minute of washing.
moisture.see_pro: Cracking, itching or flaking that won't settle is worth showing to a doctor.

oiliness.label: Oil
oiliness.what: shine and oil, mostly across the T zone
habits: Keep moisturising: stripping oil can make skin produce more.
Blotting papers are fine during the day.

pore.label: Pores
habits: Pore size is mostly genetic; the aim is clearer pores, not smaller ones.

redness.label: Redness
redness.what: areas of redness and visible flushing
habits: Notice triggers such as heat, spicy food or harsh scrubs.
Fragrance free products are a safer start.
redness.see_pro: Persistent redness, flushing or bumps can be rosacea; a doctor can confirm.

texture.label: Texture
texture.what: how smooth or uneven the surface looks
habits: Exfoliate gently, a few times a week at most.

wrinkle.label: Lines
habits: Daily sunscreen does more for lines than any single serum.

dark_circle_v2.label: Dark circles
dark_circle_v2.what: shadowing and colour under the eyes
habits: Dark circles are often genetic or from shadows; sleep helps some people.

eye_bag.label: Under eye puffiness
habits: Less salt in the evening and a slightly raised pillow can help.
eye_bag.see_pro: Sudden or one sided swelling is worth checking with a doctor.

age_spot.label: Spots
habits: Spots fade slowly and return quickly without daily sunscreen.
age_spot.see_pro: Any spot that changes shape, size or colour should be checked by a doctor.

radiance.label: Glow
radiance.what: how bright and even the skin looks
habits: Hydration and gentle exfoliation both add glow.

firmness.label: Firmness
firmness.what: how firm and lifted the skin looks
habits: Firmness changes slowly; protecting from sun matters most.

droopy_upper_eyelid.label: Upper eyelid
droopy_upper_eyelid.what: how much the upper lid folds down
droopy_upper_eyelid.see_pro: If a heavy lid affects your vision, an eye doctor can assess it.

droopy_lower_eyelid.label: Lower eyelid
droopy_lower_eyelid.what: how much the lower lid sags
habits: Use eye specific retinol products and keep them away from the lash line.

tear_trough.label: Under eye hollows
tear_trough.what: the groove between the lower lid and cheek
habits: Mostly structural; skincare softens the look only a little.

skin_type.label: Skin type
skin_type.what: whether skin reads as dry, oily, combination or normal
